company.name: Svix
company.shortDescription: Svix is the webhooks-as-a-service platform that empowers companies of all sizes to send webhooks easily and reliably.
company.description: Svix is the webhooks-as-a-service platform that empowers companies of all sizes to send webhooks easily and reliably. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in New York, United States.

productsAndServices.description: An API-driven webhook sending platform that manages webhook delivery, retries, security, and scalability for developers.
productsAndServices.name: Svix Core

productsAndServices.description: A webhook receiving gateway that securely receives, verifies, processes, and routes incoming webhooks with scalability and low latency.
productsAndServices.name: Svix Ingest

productsAndServices.description: A standalone or embeddable user interface for managing webhook endpoints, viewing logs, and inspecting webhook delivery reports.
productsAndServices.name: Svix Application Portal

productsAndServices.description: A free web-based webhook tester and debugger for inspecting, testing, and debugging incoming webhooks from any service.
productsAndServices.name: Svix Play

productsAndServices.description: An alternative webhook delivery method allowing users to poll a URL to retrieve webhook events in real-time or batches instead of receiving push notifications.
productsAndServices.name: Polling Endpoints

productsAndServices.description: A feature that uses AI to generate JavaScript code for transforming webhook payloads to formats required by external services.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Generated Transformation Templates

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $7,750,000, or 59.61% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,827,543 to $56,878,194, a 20.12x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 27 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
